The Wordette

A word a day from the GZAAT Gazette. Come back tomorrow for a new one.

How to play

Guess the word in six tries. Every guess has to be a real five-letter word.

After each guess the tiles change colour to show how close you were.

PAPER

P is in the word and in the right place.

PRINT

I is in the word, but somewhere else.

STORY

R is not in the word at all.

A new puzzle is published every day at midnight. Everyone reading the GZAAT Gazette gets the same word.
